items.title: John Altman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 14, 2023
items.q: Is that Bach or is that Stravinsky?

ctx.x: Yeah. So if a representative of an ad agency is having a meeting with you and they’re selling paper towels, did you have to learn how to interpret the way they spoke about music into actual music?

Oh absolutely. And I think very helpful for that was my academic background in English literature. Because I was always looking to try and comprehend subtext of anything that people said. And what was always very interesting was you would often get people saying, “I want a jazz track.” And that could mean Louis Armstrong or it could mean Ornette Coleman. You know, I want something classical. Is that Bach or is that Stravinsky? I want country & western. Do you mean a hoedown or do you mean Dolly Parton? It’s very…
guitarist, “If I heard a noise in my head could you play it?” And he said, “Well actually I had five years medical training, I could probably cure it.”
